subject: Human Evolution
title: Homo Naledi's Chamber
description: A micro-lesson that makes Homo Naledi's Chamber usable.

hook.text: In 2013, cavers squeezed through a 18-cm gap in South Africa's Rising Star cave and found a chamber of bones.

buildup.text: Lee Berger assembled a team of slender scientists who could fit through the passage to excavate.

discovery.text: Over 1,500 bones from at least 15 individuals of a new species: Homo naledi, with a tiny brain.

twist.text: Naledi's brain was orange-sized, yet the bodies appear deliberately placed—possible ritual burial.

climax.text: If small-brained naledi buried their dead, complex behavior doesn't require a big brain after all.

punchline.text: A tiny brain may have grasped big ideas.

quiz.question: What was surprising about Homo naledi?
options: Possible ritual burial despite a small brain
